checkpoints.note: First project-side read that materializes the attacker-controlled config bytes into the heap line buffer later underwritten on the crashing path.

The vulnerable parser strips a trailing LF without first proving that the line is non-empty. When `strlen(line)` returns 0, `end == line` and `end - 1` points before the heap buffer. The patch fixes this exact obligation by wrapping the write in `if (end > line && *(end - 1) == '\n')`.
